# First, let me check the current player position and the blue region boundaries

player = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b'][0]

print(f"Player boundary: {player_boundary}")

# Find the blue region the player is in
blue_regions = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'S']
print(f"\nBlue regions: {len(blue_regions)}")
for br in blue_regions:
    center_r = sum(pt[0] for pt in br['boundary']) // len(br['boundary'])
    center_c = sum(pt[1] for pt in br['boundary']) // len(br['boundary'])
    print(f"  At ({center_r}, {center_c}), {br['pixels']} cells")
    # Check if player is adjacent to this blue region
    for adj in seg['adjacency_list']:
        if (adj[0] == player['id'] and adj[1] == br['id']) or (adj[1] == player['id'] and adj[0] == br['id']):
            print(f"    Player is adjacent to this blue region")

# Try moving the player RIGHT multiple times to see if it can reach a different area
# The player is currently at column ~20. Let me try moving RIGHT to column ~40
result = action(['RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT'])
print(f"\nAfter moving RIGHT 10 times:")
print(f"State: {result.get('state')}")
print(f"Game over: {result.get('game_over')}")
print(f"Level completed: {result.get('level_completed')}")

# Check player position
player2 = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
if player2:
    p = player2[0]
    center_r = sum(pt[0] for pt in p['boundary']) // len(p['boundary'])
    center_c = sum(pt[1] for pt in p['boundary']) // len(p['boundary'])
    print(f"Player now at ({center_r}, {center_c})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
